=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/stable_e2e_step_wait_review.sh:43-50, 183-210, 215-222, 406-414 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: The #8004 Phase 4 review deadline extension logic was lost in the forward-merge conflict resolution and is absent from the script, so the deadline check at lines 218-222 still hard-fails at the 90-minute base deadline.
  WHY: Phase 4 still exits with status=timeout while the review run is active, which is the failure from run 39969947939. The new tests fail in CI with `Missing marker: # BEGIN phase4 review deadline extension (#8004)`. Severity is BLOCKER in all three reviews.
- tests/test_test_and_mark_stable_review_blocked_budget.py:668-680 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: The `_phase4_step` and `_phase4_deadline_extension_block` helpers slice the workflow YAML, but the Phase 4 body now lives in scripts/stable_e2e_step_wait_review.sh. Some assertions also depend on workflow indentation.
  WHY: The tests cannot pass after the logic is ported unless they read the script. Severity disagreement: anthropic rated it MAJOR; minimax and qwen rated it BLOCKER. The highest is used.
- agents.d/8004-phase4-review-deadline-extension.md:2-4 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: The fragment registers the contractual log prefix `E2E_REVIEW_DEADLINE_EXTENDED` and points at the workflow, but no script emits the prefix.
  WHY: The registry advertises behaviour that is not shipped, and the pointer should go to the script once the logic is ported. All three reviewers rated it MAJOR.
- changelog.d/8004-phase4-review-deadline-extension.md:17-23 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: The changelog says the extension logic sits between BEGIN/END markers in `.github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml`, but the Phase 4 body now lives in scripts/stable_e2e_step_wait_review.sh.
  WHY: Release notes and contributors are sent to the wrong file. Severity disagreement: anthropic and minimax rated it MAJOR; qwen rated it NIT. The highest is used.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:693-695 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: `E2E_JOB_STARTED_EPOCH` is exported with a comment saying Phase 4 (#8004) uses it for its ceiling, but only stable_e2e_step_verify_bait_removed.sh:433-434 reads it.
  WHY: The comment documents behaviour the code does not deliver and could mask the missing logic.
- scripts/stable_e2e_step_wait_review.sh:(to be added) review_phase_deadline_extension_allowed | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: The script runs under `set -euo pipefail`, so every env read in the ported extension logic needs a `${VAR:-}` default and an `^[0-9]+$` guard.
  WHY: Without them an unset or malformed value crashes the step with an unbound-variable or arithmetic error instead of falling back to a clean timeout. Anthropic rated it MINOR; the other two raised it as a hardening suggestion with risk score 3.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: Phase 4 keeps waiting past the 90-minute base deadline while the watched review run is queued or active, capped at the job-start ceiling, logs `E2E_REVIEW_DEADLINE_EXTENDED` once, and gives one hand-off poll after a dropped run or pin advance without bypassing the inactivity or per-step stall checks.
  expected_change_site: scripts/stable_e2e_step_wait_review.sh (deadline setup lines 43-50, require_bait_review_coverage drops at lines 192 and 203, deadline check at lines 218-222, pin-advance branch at lines 406-414); tests/test_test_and_mark_stable_review_blocked_budget.py helpers must read the script
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  EVIDENCE: The only workflow change is the comment at .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:690-697 and no scripts/ file is touched, and no `review_phase_deadline_extension_allowed`, `REVIEW_PHASE_DEADLINE_CEILING`, `REVIEW_PHASE_HANDOFF_PENDING` or `E2E_REVIEW_DEADLINE_EXTENDED` exists in executable code. The deadline check at lines 218-222 is the unmodified original. CI fails with `Missing marker: # BEGIN phase4 review deadline extension (#8004)`.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/stable_e2e_step_wait_review.sh:43-50, 183-210, 215-222, 406-414 | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The #8004 extension logic was never ported. Merge d0aa988 took main's side after #7991 extracted the Phase 4 body into the script. None of the extension identifiers exist in any script or workflow.
  WHY: Phase 4 still times out at lines 218-222 while the review run is active, and the six new tests fail in CI. The reviewer lists the parts the fix needs: a ceiling, an allow function, the handoff flag, the deadline check rewrite, and clearing the flag.
- tests/test_test_and_mark_stable_review_blocked_budget.py:668-680, 725-731, 774-790, 797-813 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: `_phase4_step` and the `_phase4_*` helpers slice the workflow, where the Phase 4 body no longer exists, and the assertions depend on workflow indentation such as `check.index("          else\n")`.
  WHY: The tests cannot pass against the post-#7991 layout.
- scripts/stable_e2e_step_wait_review.sh (to be added) review_phase_deadline_extension_allowed | severity=MINOR | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: Every new env read needs a `${VAR:-}` default and an `^[0-9]+$` check under `set -euo pipefail`.
  WHY: Otherwise an unset or empty value crashes the step instead of producing the clean timeout.
- agents.d/8004-phase4-review-deadline-extension.md:2-4; changelog.d/8004-phase4-review-deadline-extension.md:17-23 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The log prefix `E2E_REVIEW_DEADLINE_EXTENDED` is registered but no script emits it, and the changelog points at the workflow instead of the script.
  WHY: Log analysis and release notes describe behaviour that is not shipped. This is not a runtime failure.
- TASK_GAP:
  Requirement: Phase 4 keeps waiting past the 90-minute base deadline while the review run is queued or active. It is capped at a job-start ceiling, logs `E2E_REVIEW_DEADLINE_EXTENDED` once, and gives one hand-off poll after a dropped run or pin advance without bypassing the inactivity or per-step stall checks.
  Expected change site: scripts/stable_e2e_step_wait_review.sh (lines 43-50, 192, 203, 218-222, 406-414)
  Evidence of absence: The only workflow change is the comment at .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:693-694. No scripts/ file is touched. Line 48 sets only the fixed `REVIEW_PHASE_DEADLINE`. `E2E_JOB_STARTED_EPOCH` is exported at workflow line 695 but only scripts/stable_e2e_step_verify_bait_removed.sh reads it.
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
- Hardening: guard all budget reads with `[[ "${VAR:-}" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]]` and use the base deadline as the ceiling if any is malformed (about 6 lines). HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 3
=== END FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===

  WHY: The stale location claim sends contributors to the wrong file.

  Requirement: The forward-merge PR should carry the stable bug fix, which is the Phase 4 deadline extension: wait past 90 minutes while the review run is queued or active, capped at the job-start ceiling, log `E2E_REVIEW_DEADLINE_EXTENDED` once, and give one hand-off poll after a dropped run or pin advance.
  Expected change site: scripts/stable_e2e_step_wait_review.sh (line 48 deadline setup, lines 218-222 check, the `require_bait_review_coverage` block, the `PIN_SHA="${PIN_HEAD_NOW}"` pin-advance branch)
  Evidence of absence: Repo-wide grep finds the identifiers only in the new test file and the agents.d registration. The deadline check at lines 218-222 is unmodified. CI run 40033407420 fails at tests/test_test_and_mark_stable_review_blocked_budget.py:675. The test must also be updated to read the script.
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
- Hardening: scripts/stable_e2e_step_wait_review.sh near line 218. Read each value with `${VAR:-}`, validate numerics with `^[0-9]+$`, and fall through to the timeout path on a malformed value (about 6 lines). HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 3
